<js>
var v="0"
if(v=="1"){
	//一行个数
var nums = 4 ;
//分隔符
var separator = '::'

//标题::链接::一行个数::分类

all=[

"围城::围城::::a",
"三体::三体::::a",
"基督山伯爵::基督山伯爵::::a",
"Sue Grafton::Sue Grafton::::a",
];

//@天天gg@酷安 下面不要动
function parse(data){
	let args=data.split(separator);
	let title = args[0],url=args[1],num=nums;
	
	//链接生成
	 let u=/^\d+/.test(url)?"https://zh.usa1lib.org/s/"+url+"?page={{page}}":url;
 try {num = args[2] }catch(e){}
 try {tag = args[3];
 u=tag=="a"?'https://zh.usa1lib.org/s/'+url+'?page={{page}}':u;

 }catch(e){}
	return [title, u, num]
	}

function FlexBox(title, url, num){
		 let obj={};
		 obj.style={},obj.title=title,obj.url=url?url:'',obj.style['layout_flexGrow']=1;
	//数值设定
	let data={1:1,2:0.4,3:0.25,4:0.2,5:0.15,7:0.1,10:0.05};
obj.style['layout_flexBasisPercent']=data[num]
		return obj
		}
result=JSON.stringify(all.map(data=>{
	let args=parse(data);
	return FlexBox.apply(null, args)
	}))
	}

</js>

    var tab = tabsDiv.get(i);
    var tabId = tab.id();  
    var vol = volMap[tabId];  

    var items = tab.select("ul li .item-link");
    var tempItems = [];  

    for (var j = 0; j < items.size(); j++) {
        var item = items.get(j);
        var link = item.select("a").first();
        var text = link.text().trim();
        var href = link.attr("href");
        tempItems.push({ text: text, url: href, vol: vol });
    }

    // 根据变量z判断排序方式
    if (z == "目录乱序") {
        // 按数字升序排序
        tempItems.sort(function(a, b) {
            var numA = (a.text.match(/\d+/) || [0])[0];
            var numB = (b.text.match(/\d+/) || [0])[0];
            return parseInt(numA, 10) - parseInt(numB, 10);
        });
    } else {
        // 默认倒序
        tempItems.reverse();
    }

    result = result.concat(tempItems);
}

result;

</js>

var volMap = {};
var tabs = document.select(".buttons-tab a");
for (var i = 0; i < tabs.size(); i++) {
    var element = tabs.get(i);
    var text = element.text();
    var href = element.attr("href").substring(1);  
    volMap[href] = text;
}
var result = [];
var tabsDiv = document.select(".tabs .tab");
for (var i = 0; i < tabsDiv.size(); i++) {
    var tab = tabsDiv.get(i);
    var tabId = tab.id();  
    var vol = volMap[tabId];  

    var items = tab.select("ul li .item-link");
    var tempItems = [];  

    for (var j = 0; j < items.size(); j++) {
        var item = items.get(j);
        var link = item.select("a").first();
        var text = link.text();
        var href = link.attr("href");
        tempItems.push({
            text: text,
            url: href,
            vol: vol
        });
    }
    tempItems.reverse();
    result = result.concat(tempItems);
}
result;
</js>

        var text = link.text();
        var href = link.attr("href");
        tempItems.push({
            text: text,
            url: href,
            vol: vol
        });
    }
    tempItems.reverse();
    result = result.concat(tempItems);
}
